name: Benevolence
overview: Benevolence in Scripture is demonstrated as a vital expression of God's love and a mark of true religion, calling believers to actively give to the needy and care for those in affliction, such as widows and orphans. It reflects God's own generosity, exemplified supremely in the giving of His Son, and is to be practiced with kindness, forgiveness, and readiness to do good, especially toward fellow believers. Those who withhold help from the poor invite judgment, whereas those who give generously are promised provision and blessing.
